articles.title: Hennebont National Stud Farm / K architectures
english: The Hennebont National Stud Farm, completed in 2025 in Saint-Martin-de-Mailloc, France, showcases a unique architectural design that harmonizes with its historic surroundings. This project is significant for its emphasis on equestrian activities, particularly through the newly constructed performance hall.

The equestrian performance hall is strategically placed within the Cour du Puits, one of the two historic courtyards of the stud farm, creating a seamless connection between old and new architecture. The design prioritizes not only functionality but also the aesthetic experience of horse performance events.

Emphasizing an architecture of resonance, this facility invites an appreciation of both the equestrian arts and the historical context in which it resides. It serves as a vibrant hub for events and gatherings, complimenting the cultural heritage of the region.
chinese: 亨內邦國家種馬場於2025年完成，位於法國的聖馬丁德梅勒克，展示了與歷史環境和諧共存的獨特建築設計。這個項目對於馬術活動的重視尤為重要，特別是透過新建的表演廳。
馬術表演廳戰略性地設置在種馬場兩個歷史庭院之一的泉水庭院內，實現了舊建築與新建築之間的無縫連接。這一設計不僅優先考慮功能性，還兼顧馬術表演事件的美學體驗。
強調共鳴建築的這個設施，邀請人們欣賞馬術藝術與其歷史背景。它作為活動和聚會的活躍中心，輔助了該地區的文化遺產。

articles.title: Superlimão 3D-prints pavilion for inaugural Brazilian Architecture Biennial
english: The Brazilian Architecture Biennial marked its inaugural event in São Paulo, showcasing innovative pavilions designed by local architecture studios. Among them, Superlimão presented Casa Superlimão, a striking structure made with 3D-printed concrete inspired by the natural form of banana leaf stems, reflecting a blend of modern technology and traditional influences.

Superlimão's pavilion features not only a unique support system constructed from engineered wood but also integrates sustainable materials such as recycled PET wool. This architectural approach honors Brazil's indigenous building methods while presenting a contemporary twist, aiming to resonate with all Brazilians regardless of their regional backgrounds.

Other studios like H2C Arquitetura and Vida de Vila contributed their interpretations of local vernacular architecture, emphasizing the importance of materiality and traditional techniques in modern design. Each pavilion serves as a testament to the evolving dialogue between history, technology, and the unique climatic conditions of Brazil.
chinese: 巴西建築雙年展在聖保羅首次舉辦，展示了當地建築工作室設計的創新展館。其中，Superlimão展示了Casa Superlimão，這是一座引人注目的結構，由3D列印混凝土製成，靈感來自香蕉葉莖的自然形狀，反映了現代技術和傳統影響的融合。
Superlimão的展館不僅具有由工程木材構成的獨特支撐系統，還整合了回收的PET毛料等可持續材料。這一建築方法尊重巴西的土著建築方法，同時呈現出當代的變化，旨在與所有住在巴西的人產生共鳴，無論他們的地區背景如何。
其他工作室如H2C Arquitetura和Vida de Vila則對當地的民俗建築進行了解讀，強調材料性和傳統技術在現代設計中的重要性。每個展館都作為歷史、技術和巴西獨特氣候條件之間不斷演變的對話的見證。

articles.title: xi’an international football center opens its stadium bowl to the city through a porous form
english: The Xi'an International Football Center redefines the role of a stadium in urban settings by presenting it as an open civic infrastructure. By introducing a more porous design, it allows for public activities beyond match days, transforming the stadium into a continuously active part of the city. This innovative approach addresses the limitations of traditional stadiums, which often serve as isolated structures, disconnecting from everyday urban life.

This project introduces the ‘open civic stadium’ concept, focusing on accessibility and community engagement. By embedding lower seating areas partially underground, the design minimizes the stadium’s height and visual impact. The commercial spaces around the perimeter provide a lively urban edge that connects the venue to its surroundings, creating a symbiotic relationship with the city.

During events, the stadium experience is designed to extend into the city, allowing sound and visual connections to flow outward. Certain areas are crafted for informal viewing, enabling spectators to engage with the atmosphere. The external plaza serves as a vibrant fan zone, fostering collective experiences and integrating football culture into the daily life of the community.
chinese: 西安國際足球中心重新定義了體育場在城市中的角色，將其視為開放的公共基礎設施。通過引入更具孔隙度的設計，它允許公共活動超越比賽日，將體育場轉變為城市中持續活躍的一部分。這一創新方法解決了傳統體育場的局限性，後者通常作為孤立的結構，與日常城市生活脫節。
該項目引入了“開放公共體育場”的概念，專注於可達性和社區參與。通過將底層座位區部分埋入地下，設計降低了體育場的高度和視覺影響。圍繞體育場周邊的商業空間提供了生機勃勃的城市邊緣，連接場館與周圍環境，創造出與城市的共生關係。
在活動期間，體育場體驗被設計成延伸至城市，允許聲音和視覺聯繫流向外部。某些區域被設計為非正式觀賽區，使觀眾能夠參與氣氛。外部廣場作為活力四射的粉絲區，促進集體體驗，並將足球文化融入社區的日常生活。
